items.q: What old mistake shows up again?
items.a: **Null** returns in auth/processing paths (Hoare's billion-dollar mistake).

items.q: How has AI changed the picture?
items.a: Models can **reproduce vulns in minutes**, so default attack surface matters more.
**Don't expose sshd** on default container images; minimize the attack surface.
